units.source_text: 当然，一开始谁都会想象“失踪”与秘密的男女关系有牵连。

en.t: Naturally, at first anyone would imagine that the disappearance was connected with some secret relationship between a man and a woman.

units.source_text: 可从他妻子嘴里听说，他旅行的目的仅仅是为了去采集昆虫标本。

en.t: But according to what his wife said, the sole purpose of his trip was to go and collect insect specimens.

units.source_text: 负责调查的警官也好，单位里的同事也好，都觉得自己的思路像是被什么东西岔开了似的。

en.t: The police officer in charge of the investigation and his colleagues at work alike felt as if their line of thought had somehow been diverted.

units.source_text: 真的，把杀虫瓶、捕虫网作为“情爱逃亡”的隐身草，那实在有些糊涂过头了。

en.t: Really, to treat an insect-killing jar and a butterfly net as cover for a romantic elopement was going a little too far in foolishness.

units.source_text: 而且，据火车站的检票员回忆，的确看到过一个登山队员模样的人；

en.t: Moreover, according to the ticket collector at the station, he did indeed remember seeing a man who looked like a member of a mountaineering party.

units.source_text: 他把画具盒似的木箱和水壶，交叉地背在肩上，在S车站下了车；

en.t: The man had a wooden box like an artist's paint box and a water bottle slung crosswise over his shoulders, and he got off at S Station.

units.source_text: 据检票员的证词，确实只看到他一个人，没见有同行者；

en.t: According to the ticket collector's testimony, he had definitely seen only the man himself and had not seen any companion with him.

units.source_text: 于是，“情爱逃亡”的推测显然就站不住脚了。

en.t: Thus the theory of a romantic elopement clearly no longer held up.
